Whoop is the wearable trusted by elite athletes, professional teams, and Olympians. 1. Advanced Biometric Sensors

Whoop 5.0 Peak is equipped with next-generation sensors to monitor your body 24/7. These include:

  • Heart Rate Monitor: Tracks your heart rate continuously to optimize workouts and recovery.
  • Heart Rate Variability (HRV): Provides insights into your autonomic nervous system and stress levels.
  • Respiratory Rate: Monitors breathing patterns to detect signs of fatigue, illness, or overtraining.
  • Skin Temperature: Detects subtle changes for recovery and health insights.

These sensors provide a comprehensive view of your body’s readiness each day, helping you train smarter and recover faster.

2. Personalized Recovery Score

The Whoop 5.0 Peak calculates a daily Recovery Score based on sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, and strain. This score tells you how prepared your body is for physical exertion, helping you:

  • Optimize performance and energy levels
  • Track long-term improvements in recovery and fitness

Whoop 5.0 Peak provides in-depth sleep tracking including:

By analyzing sleep patterns, Whoop helps you optimize bedtime, enhance recovery, and improve daytime performance.

Whether running, cycling, weightlifting, or practicing yoga, Whoop 5.0 Peak measures your daily cardiovascular strain and effort levels. This allows you to:

The Whoop app provides personalized, data-driven insights that help you understand your body. Features include:

  • Trends over weeks and months for long-term improvement

The Whoop 5.0 Peak is ultra-lightweight, adjustable, and comfortable for 24/7 wear. Its minimalist design ensures it doesn’t interfere with workouts, sleep, or daily life, making it ideal for continuous tracking without discomfort.

Whoop 5.0 Peak comes with a 1-year free subscription, giving you full access to all app features, personalized coaching, analytics, and long-term trend reports without additional costs.
